title: finding(vscode-extension): `HoverProvider` teaches the `body` child-list spelling in four places and never mentions `children` — the teaching corpus objectui#6771 step 5 names
body:
Blocked-by: #6771

（由分诊席 R+318 写入:本卡是 #6771 step 5「教学语料」那一群的一块,而 #6771 现读 pm:dispatched、assignee os-sales、priority:p1,在飞;时序归它。⚠️ 本卡的改动今天技术上安全（两种拼写都还解析），挡住它的是撞车风险与归属,⛔ 不是技术前提。 依据见评论 5735773742。）

`packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/HoverProvider.ts` **teaches** the `body` child-list spelling to whoever hovers a schema key in the editor. Seat-verified at source on `origin/main` **00c4df509**, printed rather than counted:

```
:72       body: `**body** (object | array)
:83   "body": [
:185    "body": [...]
:199    "body": {...}
```

⭐ Control in the same command: **`children` does not occur in that file at all** — the instrument reads the file (four `body` hits above) and the canonical spelling is simply absent from it.

## Class (c) — it is documentation that steers an author toward a key the platform is retiring

⛔ It is **not** a producer: the hover writes nothing into anyone's document, which is why the objectui#9871 scan correctly scores it **out** (it fails C1 EMISSION). ⇒ ⛔ it does not belong in that card's producer table, and folding it in would corrupt the very criterion that card exists to establish.

⭐ It is exactly objectui#6771 **step 5**'s population — the teaching corpus. A reader (very often an AI assistant reading hover text) is shown `body` as the way to spell a child list, while the platform's own migration has moved every producer to `children`.

## What this card does ⛔ NOT claim

- ⛔ Not that anything is broken today: both spellings still resolve in the readers, so a hover-taught `body` renders.
- ⛔ Not a proposal about WHEN step 5 happens. Whether the teaching corpus moves now or with the rest of step 5 is objectui#6771's to sequence; this card exists so that population is written down with a measurement instead of being rediscovered.

## Dedupe words

`hover provider teaches body dialect` · `vscode HoverProvider documentation body` · `teaching corpus step 5 hover` · `editor hover child list spelling` · `body dialect documentation site`

## Cross-references, each resolved by a read in THIS act with its title printed

- objectui#9871 — *make the `body`-dialect producer table come from a SCAN, not an enumeration — the first deliverable is the CRITERION, not another count* (open; its scan scores this file OUT, and its dev surfaced this)
- objectui#6771 — *finding(sdui-parser/components): the manifest tier reports `unknown-prop` on `body` — the one child-list key 10+ registrations actually honour* (open; its step 5 is the teaching corpus this card measures)
